name: Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Ltd.
source: KERC Combined Tariff Order 2025 (27 March 2025), Annexure 9, Tariff Schedule LT-1 for FY2026-27 (page 534). Pension and gratuity surcharge: KERC order of 18 March 2025. Electricity tax: Government of Karnataka, 9% under the Karnataka Electricity (Taxation on Consumption or Sale) Act.

bill_inputs.label: Fuel and power purchase cost adjustment (FPPCA)
bill_inputs.note: Changes every month. We use the FPPCA printed on your bill, and ₹0 if it isn't shown.

notes: If you get free units under Gruha Jyothi, your savings will be lower than shown, because the scheme already covers part of your bill.
The FY 2024-25 true-up charge (May 2026 to April 2027) is fixed from last year's use, so solar doesn't change it. We leave it out.

net_metering.note: We don't carry extra units into later months for Karnataka, and count them as ₹0, so the savings shown are on the low side.

common_area.note: Water supply installations and lifts serviced separately for residential complexes are billed on LT-1 Domestic; KERC added a common-area description for residential apartments.
common_area.source: KERC Combined Tariff Order 2025 (27 March 2025), Tariff Schedule LT-1, item (n) (page 547), and para 6.5.6 (page 219).
